  PROBLEM: The retarget guard and matching jq select exclude only `merged`, not `skipped`, even though the early-branch guard excludes both. A later-round re-issue request for the same item can overwrite a `skipped` entry back to `pending`, losing the `unblock_superseded_by` marker. The test suite does not exercise this path.
  WHY: A re-issued original can be resurrected from `skipped` into `pending`, invalidating the consolidation that depended on it being `skipped`.

- Requirement: Workflow hardening deliverables from the linked issue (pin `jlumbroso/free-disk-space@v1.3.1` to SHA `54081f138730dfa15788a46383842cd2f914a1be`; replace `x-access-token:${{ secrets.GH_PAT }}` interpolation with `${GH_TOKEN}` in the two push steps; add `tests/test_workflow_secret_hardening.py`; add `changelog.d/wfopt-2026-09-18-workflow-secret-hardening.md`).
  Expected change site: `.github/workflows/review_autofix.yml` (free-disk-space reference at ~line 1938 and "Push all pending commits" step at ~line 4591); `.github/workflows/implement.yml` ("Push branch" step at ~line 5153); `tests/test_workflow_secret_hardening.py`; `changelog.d/wfopt-2026-09-18-workflow-secret-hardening.md`.
  Evidence of absence: The PR description scopes this PR to the poller fix for project #7355 ("Refs #7355") and states that the unblock judge's `reissue` verdict re-issued #7357 as #7367 and closed #7357 as `not_planned`. The hardening content now lives under #7367, so this PR touches neither workflow file, adds no `tests/test_workflow_secret_hardening.py`, and adds only `changelog.d/7372-unblock-reissue-wave-entry.md`. The hardening work is deferred to #7367 rather than missing from this PR's scope.
  SEVERITY: NIT
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTIONS: scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh, retarget guard at ~line 18768 and retarget jq select at ~line 18776. The early-branch guard (`IN("merged","skipped") | not`) and the filing-path retarget (only `!= "merged"`) are inconsistent, so a `skipped` original can be re-promoted to `pending` on a later-round re-issue. Suggested minimal fix: change both filters to `.status // "" | IN("merged","skipped") | not`. Estimated lines changed: 2. HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 2.
- Note: On the LAST RUN DIFF addition `| .issue_number_map[$id] = $num` (scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:18778), the autofix editor's rationale ("a second re-issue of the same entry overwrites `unblock_request_id` and goes back through the filing path on every poll") does not match the existing code. The early branch already handles the second poll via its `unblock_request_id` lookup, and the retarget select no longer matches after the first retarget. The new line is defensive rather than a correctness fix, and the test it updates (`test_fixup_hook_reissue_takes_the_original_wave_entry`) would pass without it. It is harmless, so no blocker.
